correctness.rationale: PASS: All composites are c_0. Associativity forces every f_i to fix 0 and annihilate the union of all nonzero generator images. Prescribing cells t_S selects labeled image membership subsets in n!/(r!∏t_S!) ways, and each f_i is independently a surjection from r free inputs (plus a forced zero dummy) onto a_i nonzero images plus zero; the number is a_i! S(r+1,a_i+1). Thus the exact product formula is positive iff r>=max_i a_i; this proves the minimal carrier threshold. Every partition of the m+1-element source null semigroup is a congruence; partition-lattice Möbius inversion gives E_m(n)=sum_k s(m+1,k)F_(k-1)(n). Independent exhaustive enumeration of all pointed maps for m=2 and n=1..4 reproduced totals 1,7,52,553 and faithful totals 0,0,24,432, and checked every realized exact cell profile against the formula. This finite verification corroborates the all-m,n combinatorial argument.
